subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four assertion repairs pass, should the exact grouped set of privileged action revisions be accepted for the token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: Verified provenance reduces supply-chain uncertainty, but accepting new third-party executable code in secret-bearing and security-owned workflows remains an owner decision.

options.title: Approve the repaired group
options.body: Accept all verified revisions together after the focused tests pass and required CODEOWNERS approve the exact head.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex action updates into smaller PRs for independent owner review.

recommendation.title: Approve the repaired group
recommendation.body: Accept all verified revisions together after the focused tests pass and required CODEOWNERS approve the exact head.
